;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Timeline of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict in 2020|Israeli-Palestinian attacks]]
***[[Israel]]i [[Israel Defense Forces|troops]] kill a 15-year-old  boy and wound four others at the [[Fawwar, Hebron|Al-Fawar refugee camp]] near [[Hebron]], where they are looking for the [[rock throw]]er who killed a soldier yesterday. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/Hy6JF7K58 (Ynetnews)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
****[[New York City]] goes 58 consecutive days without a fatal pedestrian traffic collision, the most since tracking began in 1983. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/york-city-breaks-record-58-straight-days-pedestrian/story?id=70654065 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland]]
****[[Governor of Maryland|Maryland Governor]] [[Larry Hogan]] announces that the stay-at-home order will be lifted on May 15, except for Prince George's and Montgomery counties. Groups of over ten will remain forbidden. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/497646-maryland-to-lift-stay-at-home-order-starting-friday (''The Hill'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
***[[Poland]] extends its ban on foreigners entering the country until June 12 due to [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-poland-borders/poland-to-keep-borders-closed-for-foreigners-until-june-12-idUSKBN22P190 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lesotho]]
***[[Lesotho]] reports its first case, an asymptomatic person who returned from [[Saudi Arabia]]. Eighty others test negative. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/may/13/lesotho-records-first-coronavirus-case-a-week-after-lifting-lockdown (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
***Due to a spike in cases, the [[Government of Chile|government]] announces a total lockdown in [[Santiago]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/05/13/world/americas/13reuters-health-coronavirus-chile.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 California's 25th congressional district special election]]
**[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] [[Christy Smith (politician)|Christy Smith]] concedes defeat to [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Mike Garcia (politician)|Mike Garcia]] in yesterday's special election for [[California's 25th congressional district]] after vote returns showed Garcia in the lead. The results are the first time since [[1998 United States House of Representatives elections|1998]] that Republicans flipped a Democratic-held [[United States House of Representatives|House]] seat in [[California]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/05/13/politics/mike-garcia-christy-smith-california-25-congressional-seat/index.html (CNN)] [https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/497326-Democrats-lose-house-seat-in-contested-california-special-election (''The Hill'')]
*[[Tom Thabane]] steps down as [[Prime Minister of Lesotho|Prime Minister]] of [[Lesotho]] following investigations into his third wife's alleged murder of his second wife, [[Lipolelo Thabane]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics-thabane-newsmaker/murder-case-claims-turbulent-career-of-veteran-lesotho-pm-idUSKBN22P0BB (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[2020 AFL season|2020 Australian Football League season]]
***Plans to restart the 2020 AFL season on June 11 have been halted after the [[South Australia]]n [[government of South Australia|government]] announced it would not allow the [[Adelaide Football Club|Adelaide]] and [[Port Adelaide Football Club|Port Adelaide]] clubs to be exempt from the 14-day mandatory quarantine. [[Western Australia]]n-based teams [[Fremantle Football Club|Fremantle]] and [[West Coast Eagles|West Coast]] have plans to temporarily relocate to [[Gold Coast, Queensland]]. [https://www.news.com.au/sport/afl/health-officials-choose-not-to-provide-exemptions-for-south-australian-players/news-story/21c9069bc0227c850a790d421c7c686d (News.com.au)]
